text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I somehow managed to finish the Kinko Sho. 
Fans called out to me afterward, but... I 
just didn't know what kind of face to 
make.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Miss Sweep wanted me to just be 
"myself"... but surely that's not how a 
proper "princess" should be, is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"When I was feeling lost, Trainer-san 
asked me to look upon my 'ideal self' one 
more time."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lost and wandering, one thing remained 
crystal clear: she couldn't possibly run 
the Victoria Mile like this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "Takamatsunomiya Kinen" where a Pre-Fi 
Show will be held, and where my idol 
King-san will run. If I go there, will 
something inside me change...?
